description: Arithmetic, not a price opinion: the middle half of closed-sale price per square foot (25th–75th percentile) for a complex, or for attached or detached homes island-wide, times the given heated square feet. For a real CMA, send the person to request_contact.

island.description: kiawah = Kiawah Island (incl. Cassique and Orange Hill on Johns Island); seabrook = Seabrook Island

kind.description: For the island-wide figure: attached (villa, townhome) or detached

neighborhood.description: Optional name or slug; without it, or when the complex has under five recent sales, the island-wide figure is used

name: estimate_range

basis.description: Which sales the range rests on

what_this_is.description: Arithmetic on aggregates, not an appraisal

title: The living CMA range
